_contract: stitchu composition contract, K2 (2026-07-19). DECLARES, for every existing drawable component, its attachment point, z-order (dispatcher post-pass order in engine/src/garment.cpp) and conflict class, plus the component x host and component x component conflict matrix. The matrix declares CURRENT engine behavior; it never changes it. engine/tests/compose_check.cpp (ctest compose_check) re-derives every class by actually drafting and fails on any drift. gen-contract.mjs generates engine/src/composition.gen.hpp from this file; --check guards sync.

classes.excluded: refused at the spec boundary (engine/src/specparse.hpp validateSpecCross) with a named error
classes.validator: drafts but PatternValidator blocks the result with a named issue; the PDF is withheld (honest, visible refusal)
classes.honest: the block skips itself and says so in the guide (a guide step containing: skipped)
classes.ignored: field not applicable on this host; the engine ignores it silently BY DOCUMENTED DESIGN (halter shoulder/edge-finish family only). Any silent no-op not declared ignored fails compose_check.

components.attachment: shoulder seam + armhole (reshape / diagonal raglan seam)
front bodice, CF teardrop below the neckline
front neckline (bias re-mark / high neck band + tie strip)
CF of the front piece (grown-on stand + fold line + buttons)
placement notch at the named edge (front neck / waist / back waist / cuff)
faced neck edge, separate piece trued to the neckline; drawn over the CB seam
gathered panel trued to the zone edge (gatherZone: neckline/bust/waist/sleeve)
back piece cutout + facing trued to the opening
center-back seam of the back skirt piece, up from the hem
shoulder points of the sleeveless top edge (notch pair)
finished waist seam (inner arc trued to m.waistMM)
front panel surface (patch) / side seam (in-seam bag) / diagonal front-hip mouth + facing + bag (slash)
wrist end of a full-length sleeve
lower edge of the fitted skirt/dress-skirt/top pieces
skirt/dress hem edge (separate gathered strip)
bodice top edge dropped below the shoulder (elastic-cased band)
CF of the front piece (button circles; functional reuses the placket geometry)
CF or CB seam (teeth glyph + opened seam)
back neck edge (separate piece, attach edge trued)
bare-shoulder frame: own binding, no shoulder seam; sleeves are honestly skipped in-draft
sleeve crown (raised/gathered) or short cap wing on the armhole
neckline + sleeveless armhole raw edges (bias binding default, facing opt-in)

flatComponents._note: flat-engine (engine/flat-engine/_engine-full.mjs render()) draw order = z-order; later entries draw ON TOP. The hand-managed rule (collar on top, covering the CB line) is hereby declared. Part flags come from styles.json parts.*.

order.note: drawn FIRST so the body outline overlaps it (sleeve sits behind the shoulder)
base silhouette, front + back halves mirrored
gather ink rows on the panel; casing flag shifts the top row down
hem lace band, else hem stitch line
drawn over the body AND the neckline — the declared hand-rule: the collar sits on top and covers the CB/neck line

declaredButNotDrawn._finding: declaration-vs-code discrepancy (K2, code wins): these part flags exist in styles.json records and in the contract flat.* schema, but render() never reads them — setting them draws NOTHING. [2026-07-22: straps ÇIKARILDI — render() artık pt.straps okuyor (strapShape geri geldi 2026-07-19), ASKI ailesi wide/spaghetti bunu çiziyor; ruffledStraps+gatherWaist hala çizilmiyor].
declaredButNotDrawn.evidence: engine/flat-engine/_engine-full.mjs:33 reads only pt.sleeve/shirr/casing/tie/backSeam/cfGather/laceNeck/laceSleeve/laceHem/collar; styles.json drawstring_babydoll sets straps+ruffledStraps true

matrix._note: defaultClass applies to every host x feature single and feature x feature pair not listed below. Pairs run on a plain sleeveless A-line dress host (EU38), sleeved when a feature needs a sleeve — the same canonical hosts compose_check drafts. why = the engines own message/issue at declaration time (informative; the test re-derives it).
